scenarios.title: Preflight before any review-link click: if routing would create a Default native guest without proven isolated native storage root, record blocked before the click; switching to UUID afterwards is not safe isolation. With supported run-owned UUID routing or proven root isolation, use only owned forge fixtures, open Review and Checks for different worktrees and verify each link reveals its exact originating worktree/tab. Never authenticate or mutate a real forge.

Preflight before any in-app link: no Default native guest without proven isolated native root; record blocked before clicking if UUID routing/root isolation is unavailable. With an owned fixture and supported isolation, verify system versus app links and Shift+Cmd under both invert settings, exact URL/workspace and no fallback launch on Browser failure. Real system browser delivery also requires an explicitly isolated run-owned opener/session; otherwise record blocked rather than touching the user's browser.
